title: An accident in the street
scene: Anna sees a man fall off his bike and calls the dispatcher. The paramedics come fast and treat him for shock and trauma, give him morphine, and his adrenaline is high; in the hospital, where doctors still carry pagers, he is in a coma for a day, needs blood from a donor, and his wife is in great distress.

old_story: On Monday, Anna sees a man fall off his bike. She feels a rush of [[adrenaline]] and calls for help. The [[dispatcher]] sends an ambulance right away. Two [[paramedics|paramedic]] arrive in five minutes. The man is in [[shock]] and has head [[trauma]]. They give him [[morphine]] for the pain. At the hospital, a doctor's [[pager]] beeps, and she runs to him. The man is in a [[coma]] for one day. He needs blood from a [[donor]]. His wife is in great [[distress]], so Anna stays with her. The next evening, the man wakes up and smiles at them.

title: Uncle Petro's way back
scene: Anna's uncle is an alcoholic. After years of alcoholism he goes to rehab and also stops smoking because of the nicotine; in his group people talk about heroin and opiates, cocaine, meth, LSD and marijuana, and one man takes methadone.

old_story: Anna's uncle Petro is an [[alcoholic]], and the family has worried about him for years. Last spring, after a long fight with [[alcoholism]], he finally went to [[rehab]]. He also stopped smoking, because he did not want [[nicotine]] to control him too. In his support group, people have very different stories. One woman used [[heroin]] and other [[opiates|opiate]] for ten years. A young man talks about [[cocaine]] and [[meth]] and the friends he lost. Another man started with [[marijuana]] at parties and later tried [[LSD]]. A woman explains how [[amphetamine]] pills ruined her sleep and her job. An older man takes [[methadone]] every day to stay away from street drugs. Petro listens to everyone and feels less alone. On Sunday, he comes to family dinner, drinks only tea, and Anna hugs him.

title: The big match on TV
scene: Max and his dad watch the city derby on TV: Kyiv versus Lviv. The referee calls a foul and an offside, the goalkeeper saves a penalty, and in extra time a midfielder passes to the winger, who scores the winning goal; they watch the replay, while a fanatic dad talks about fair play and hooligans fight outside the stadium.

old_story: Max's dad is a big [[football]] [[fanatic]]. Tonight, they watch the city [[derby]] on TV together. The [[match]] is Kyiv Reds [[versus]] Kyiv Blues. In the first half, the [[referee]] calls a [[foul]] on the Reds. Later, he calls an [[offside]], and Dad shouts at the TV. In the second half, the Reds' [[goalkeeper]] saves a penalty. It is 1-1, so the game goes into [[extra time]]. In the last minute, a [[midfielder]] passes to the fast [[winger]]. He scores the winning [[goal]]! Max and his dad jump up and watch the [[replay]] five times.

title: Max at the gym
scene: Max wants to do more sport and joins a club with a fitness center. His trainer, a fitness guru, plans cardio, stretching and pilates; an older man shows off his biceps and six-pack and talks about steroids, and after the workout Max books a massage.

old_story: Max wants to do more [[sport]] this year. He joins a [[club]] with a big [[fitness center]]. His [[trainer]], Oleh, is a [[guru]] with many online followers. Oleh makes a plan to improve Max's [[fitness]]. Max does twenty minutes of [[cardio]] and some [[stretching]]. On Fridays, he even goes to a [[pilates]] class. One day, an older man shows Max his huge [[biceps]] and [[six-pack]]. "I use [[steroids|steroid]]," he says. "Do you want some?" "No, thanks," Max says. "I want to stay healthy." After the workout, he books a long massage instead.

title: The Kyiv marathon
scene: Anna starts jogging with a fitness tracker and runs her first race. At the start fast runners sprint past her - some do cross-country and triathlon too - and at the end a champion athlete stands on the podium with a gold medal and a prize, while journalists ask the other medalists about doping.

old_story: Anna loves [[jogging]] in the park every morning. She checks her speed on her new fitness [[tracker]]. In May, she runs her first race in Kyiv. At the [[start]], she feels nervous but happy. Fast [[runners|runner]] go past her in a quick [[sprint]]. Max says some of them do [[cross-country]] and [[triathlon]] too. Anna runs slowly, but she does not stop. At the end, a [[champion]] from Lviv waves to everyone. This young [[athlete]] stands on the [[podium]]. She gets a gold [[medal]] and a big [[prize]]. Journalists ask another [[medalist]] questions about [[doping]]. Anna has no medal, but she is very proud.
